passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.1
passages.text: Forte sub arguta consederat ilice Daphnis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.2
passages.text: compulerantque greges Corydon et Thyrsis in unum,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.3
passages.text: Trhyrsis ovis, Corydon distentas lacte capellas,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.4
passages.text: ambo florentes aetatibus, Arcades ambo,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.5
passages.text: et cantare pares, et respondere parati.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.6
passages.text: Huc mihi, dum teneras defendo a frigore myrtos,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.7
passages.text: vir gregis ipse caper deerraverat; atque ego Daphnim

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.8
passages.text: aspicio. Ille ubi me contra videt: “Ocius” inquit

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.9
passages.text: “huc ades, O Meliboee, caper tibi salvus et haedi;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.10
passages.text: et, si quid cessare potes, requiesce sub umbra.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.11
passages.text: huc ipsi potum venient per prata iuvenci,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.12
passages.text: hic viridis tenera praetexit arundine ripas

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.13
passages.text: Mincius, eque sacra resonant examina quercu.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.14
passages.text: Quid facerem? Neque ego Alcippen, nec Phyllida habebam,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.15
passages.text: depulsos a lacte domi quae clauderet agnos,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.16
passages.text: et certamen erat, Corydon cum Thyrside, magnum.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.17
passages.text: posthabui tamen illorum mea seria ludo:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.18
passages.text: alternis igitur contendere versibus ambo

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.19
passages.text: coepere; alternos Musae meminisse volebant.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.20
passages.text: hos Corydon, illos referebat in ordine Thyrsis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.21
passages.text: Nymphae, noster amor, Libethrides, aut mihi carmen,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.22
passages.text: quale meo Codro, concedite: proxima Phoebi

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.23
passages.text: versibus ille facit; aut, si non possumus omnes,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.24
passages.text: hic arguta sacra pendebit fistula pinu.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.25
passages.text: Pastores, hedera crescentem ornate poetam,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.26
passages.text: Arcades, invidia rumpantur ut ilia Codro;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.27
passages.text: aut si ultra placitum laudarit, baccare frontem

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.28
passages.text: cingite, ne vati noceat mala lingua futuro.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.29
passages.text: Saetosi caput hoc apri tibi, Delia, parvus

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.30
passages.text: et ramosa Micon vivacis cornua cervi.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.31
passages.text: Si proprium hoc fuerit, levi de marmore tota

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.32
passages.text: puniceo stabis suras evincta coturno.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.33
passages.text: Sinum lactis et haec te liba, Priape, quotannis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.34
passages.text: exspectare sat est: custos es pauperis horti.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.35
passages.text: Nunc te marmoreum pro tempore fecimus; at tu,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.36
passages.text: si fetura gregem suppleverit, aureus esto.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.37
passages.text: Nerine Galatea, thymo mihi dulcior Hyblae,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.38
passages.text: candidior cycnis, hedera formosior alba,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.39
passages.text: cum primum pasti repetent praesepia tauri,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.40
passages.text: si qua tui Corydonis habet te cura, venito.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.41
passages.text: Immo ego Sardoniis videar tibi amarior herbis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.42
passages.text: horridior rusco, proiecta vilior alga,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.43
passages.text: si mihi non haec lux toto iam longior anno est.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.44
passages.text: Ite domum pasti, si quis pudor, ite iuvenci.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.45
passages.text: Muscosi fontes et somno mollior herba,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.46
passages.text: et quae vos rara viridis tegit arbutus umbra,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.47
passages.text: solstitium pecori defendite; iam venit aestas

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.48
passages.text: torrida, iam lento turgent in palmite gemmae.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.49
passages.text: Hic focus et taedae pingues, hic plurimus ignis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.50
passages.text: semper, et adsidua postes fuligine nigri;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.51
passages.text: hic tantum Boreae curamus frigora, quantum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.52
passages.text: aut numerum lupus, aut torrentia flumina ripas.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.53
passages.text: Stant et iuniperi, et castaneae hirsutae;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.54
passages.text: strata iacent passim sua quaque sub arbore poma;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.55
passages.text: omnia nunc rident: at si formosus Alexis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.56
passages.text: montibus his abeat, videas et flumina sicca.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.57
passages.text: Aret ager; vitio moriens sitit aeris herba;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.58
passages.text: Liber pampineas invidit collibus umbras:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.59
passages.text: Phyllidis adventu nostrae nemus omne virebit,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.60
passages.text: Iuppiter et laeto descendet plurimus imbri.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.61
passages.text: Populus Alcidae gratissima, vitis Iaccho,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.62
passages.text: formosae myrtus Veneri, sua laurea Phoebo;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.63
passages.text: Phyllis amat corylos: illas dum Phyllis amabit,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.64
passages.text: nec myrtus vincet corylos, nec laurea Phoebi.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.65
passages.text: Fraxinus in silvis pulcherrima, pinus in hortis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.66
passages.text: populus in fluviis, abies in montibus altis:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.67
passages.text: saepius at si me, Lycida formose, revisas,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.68
passages.text: fraxinus in silvis cedat tibi, pinus in hortis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.69
passages.text: Haec memini, et victum frustra contendere Thyrsim:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 7.70
passages.text: ex illo Corydon Corydon est tempore nobis.
